---
title: "Technical & Scientific Computation with NumPy"
---

At the end of this module, you will be able to:

- Create efficient data structures called `ndarrays`
- Populate `ndarrays` with simulated or real-world data
- Manipulate `ndarrays` with a variety of scalable routines
- Carry out exploratory data analysis with NumPy
- Read and write `ndarrays` in many formats

## Module Content

This module covers the following topics:

1. [Installing NumPy](installing-numpy.qmd)
2. [NumPy ndarray](numpy-ndarray.qmd)
3. [Array Creation Routines](array-creation-routines.qmd)
4. [Array Manipulation Routines](array-manipulation-routines.qmd)
5. [Universal Functions in NumPy](universal-functions.qmd)
6. [Mathematical Functions](mathematical-functions.qmd)
7. [Statistics](statistics.qmd)
8. [Linear Algebra](linear-algebra.qmd)
9. [Pseudorandom Number Generation](pseudorandom-number-generation.qmd)
10. [File Input and Output (IO) with ndarrays](file-io-with-ndarrays.qmd)
